method: Reciprocal unique exposure within two seconds, same fibre era and integer BJD night. Standard independent nightly weights with internal-scatter check and 1 m/s floor. Fixed periods, weighted linear sine/cosine and common slope. Months grouped into July–June observing years. An intercept per era or per observing year/era. BIC assumes the stated independent Gaussian errors. Positive conditional chi-square, BIC and predictive gains favour the larger model. Leave-one-season-out uses only training velocities for coefficients. Seasonal scores concern within-season/era contrasts. Phase is time of cosine maximum after BJD 2455000 in cycles. Formal first-order covariance conditional on fixed periods, scaled by max(1,reduced chi2). Weak signals and nearly collinear harmonics have unreliable phase linearizations. Same spectra, post-selection epochs and periods, possible shared systematics and unmodelled correlated noise preclude an independent detection or fresh false-alarm probability.
